Why Integration Is Now a Platform Requirement
Old defense is broken
Large question banks and tight timers no longer stop cheating. AI on a second screen answers 60 questions in seconds, no matter how large the pool or how short the clock.
Workaround does not scale
Platforms without native proctoring push customers to bolt Zoom or Teams onto the exam to watch test takers. It breaks under volume and leaves no defensible, auditable record when a result is challenged.
Customers want one vendor
They already trust you to host content and deliver the exam. They prefer a single accountable provider for security over stitching point solutions together.
Native Integration, Enforced by Design
Bolt-on tools depend on policy
Browser extensions can be skipped. If the extension is missing, the exam still runs unproctored, and enforcement falls back to manual disqualification after the fact
Talview is enforced by design
Our native JavaScript makes proctoring a gate. The test taker cannot reach exam content until identity, environment, and lockdown checks pass. No extension, no manual enforcement, no gaps

One Integration, Every Role
Test taker
A linear flow that never breaks. Alvy, our AI proctor, handles onboarding, live troubleshooting, and guidance, cutting candidate support queries by up to 80 percent.
Instructor
Proctoring reports, video playback, and integrity scores embed directly against each candidate record inside your admin view.
Administrator
Configure proctoring rules per exam, from a single identity check to multi-camera live proctoring, through embeddable components in your own interface.
Where It Fits
Corporate training
Employee certification and compliance testing for health, medical, and technical roles, where a proctored result gates deployment.
Higher education
Summative exams on leading LMS and assessment platforms through marketplace plugin or LTI integration.
Certification and immigration
Language and credentialing tests where identity integrity decides eligibility.
In-classroom and hybrid
Exam centers running 200 to 300 students with one or two invigilators monitor the room through the Talview dashboard instead of physical invigilation.
Integration and Timeline
Day 1
Proof of concept in a day.
The candidate experience is an overlay, so a working POC can go live the same day once access is in place.
Month 1
Full delivery in one month.
Phased delivery, candidate experience first, then admin tooling, then deep report and UI embedding. Proven with 10+ partners.
Hours – 1 Week
Effort of a few hours to a week.
Depending on your stack. Real-time event webhooks across 80-plus event types keep your platform in sync throughout the session.
COMMERCIAL MODELS
Flexible commercial models to fit your platform strategy, from reseller to fully embedded, with joint go-to-market support in the early deals.
